environment.description: Container deployed via hardened Kubernetes pod spec with securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and no writable volume mounts (no emptyDir, no tmpfs, no PVC). The container image uses a distroless base. Pod runs behind an Istio service mesh sidecar (envoy proxy) with outlier detection and retry policies that add variable latency (50-200ms jitter via fault injection at mesh level). Additionally, the pod has a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) applied and runs in a namespace with ResourceQuota enforcing burstable QoS, meaning CPU throttling via CFS bandwidth control introduces non-deterministic scheduling delays of 5-50ms.

config.filesystem: overlay2, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, no volume mounts of any kind
config.network: Istio mesh with VirtualService fault injection: fixedDelay 50ms-200ms random per-request, plus mTLS enforced
config.security_context: readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true, seccompProfile: RuntimeDefault, drop ALL capabilities
config.resources: burstable QoS, cpu limit 500m with CFS period 100ms (causes throttling jitter)
config.istio_config: VirtualService with HTTPFaultInjection.Delay percentage=100 fixedDelay drawn uniformly from [50ms,200ms]
config.additional: PeerAuthentication STRICT mTLS, no direct pod access - all traffic through mesh ingress gateway
